source_record.native_common_basis: Affected disciplines supply current constraint and trade-off knowledge at consequential interfaces; real authority and representative access remain distinct from a forum or title.
source_record.common_cost_and_alternative: Coordination, knowledge upkeep, stale models, meeting latency and suppressed dissent count. A small independent decision can use direct peer interaction and a concise record.
attempted_contrary_interfaces: An option list treated as joint feasibility.
A confirming experiment rejected because the action remains unchanged.
A prototype treated as complete product qualification.
A partial input rejected for failing the whole receiver.
Sunk expenditure treated as future benefit.
Private cost preference treated as authority to waive a binding obligation.

positive_controls.argument: The named uncertainty and decision dependency identify which discipline and knowledge interface need to participate, avoiding universal attendance.
The dominant feasibility budgets and interfaces specify which disciplines and reusable knowledge are relevant and which local decisions can remain delegated.
The experiment result and its exact conditions can update reusable constraint knowledge or reveal a conflict that needs a joint decision.
The commitment question, decision rights and residual-risk criteria determine which conflict needs integration and which evidence must reach the responsible actor.
The chosen separable commitments and evidence timing define when affected disciplines need to coordinate and what reusable knowledge can remain unchanged.
The permitted tailored control package identifies necessary expertise, independent challenge or cheaper peer interaction for the specific interface.
Forecast sensitivity and commitment horizons identify which cross-functional assumptions need updating and which historical knowledge is adequate for reuse.
The real risk dimensions and authority constraints identify where specialist or independent participation is required and where delegation remains justified.
